svg.title: Install dsh-bridge in two steps
svg.desc: Step 1: in Harness open Plugins, Add plugin, enter dsh-bridge-host, Install, Apply now. Step 2: connect Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client to dsh-bridge-mcp.
